title: GDD T-104b — StagePresenter 3D: logical→world projection, StageProfiles (4 camera rigs), base prefab set (§10.4)
description: Framework (Unity) layer generalizing the Esquiva-3D scene approach per GDD §10.4. StagePresenter consumes Core RenderState (entities in logical [0,1]² + Height + EntityKind + OwnerSeat + VisualVariant, Annex D.2) and projects it into the 3D URP world according to the active StageProfile (data): camera rig topDownOrtho | frontFixed | runnerLateral | boardOverview; logical-plane-to-world mapping; EntityKind+VisualVariant -> low-poly prefab set with pooled instances and headless-safe primitive fallback (same pattern as DodgeGameBootstrap). Camera is placed at MG_INTRO and stays fixed during MG_PLAY (feedback shake <= 300 ms only; runnerLateral is the single travelling exception). Avatars get player-color tint (Rojo #E5484D, Azul #3B82F6, Amarillo #FACC15, Verde #22C55E) plus the redundant shape marker overhead (circle/square/triangle/rhombus, §8.1). Render interpolates between the two most recent sim states (§10.3 double buffer). Respect §14 budgets (unlit/simple-lit, no per-frame allocs). Read GDD §10.3/§10.4, §8.1, §14 and Annex D.1 (Esquiva-3D row) before coding. Unity Editor/MCP required for compile gate and scene verification — coordinate with orchestrator.
acceptance_criteria: StageProfile is data (camera type, plane mapping, prefab-set id) selectable per microgame definition; all 4 camera rigs implemented and placed at MG_INTRO
RenderState entities are projected every frame with interpolation between the two last sim states; steady-state rendering performs no per-frame heap allocations (pooled instances)
Camera never moves during MG_PLAY except feedback shake (<= 300 ms) — runnerLateral travelling is the only exception
Player avatars carry both channels: per-seat color tint AND the overhead shape marker (circle/square/triangle/rhombus)
Projection math (logical x,y,height -> world position per profile) is covered by fast or EditMode tests as regression locks
Headless-safe primitive fallback when a prefab is missing, mirroring the DodgeGameBootstrap pattern; compile gate clean in the Unity Editor

comments.author: orchestrator
comments.body: Render-contract dependency SETTLED (TASK-048 closed 2026-07-07): RenderEntity.VisualVariant is now documented as the GDD 10.4 discrete prefab/skin selector (EntityKind+VisualVariant -> prefab, small cardinality, no scalar packing); continuous per-entity presentation values ride the new additive RenderEntity.Progress01 (float [0,1], mechanic-defined, presentation-only, defaults 0). Apunta publishes aim-interp progress there; HudState.Meters carries the per-seat charge meter. The presenter must consume BOTH channels. CARRY-IN NIT from rev-t048 (LOW, one word): RenderEntity.cs:30's doc comment cites 'Annex D.1's worked example' for stageProfile.entityPrefabSet — the worked example actually lives in GDD 11.1 (Annex D.1 only references StageProfile generally). Fix the citation on the first touch of RenderEntity.cs during this ticket.
